attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: drupal_metadata_lookup
steps:
  - id: step_authenticate
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "cms_publisher"
    output: auth_result

  - id: step_fetch_author
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/jsonapi/node/author?filter[name]={{author_name}}"
    output: raw_author

  - id: step_fetch_category
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/jsonapi/taxonomy_term/category?filter[name]={{category_name}}"
    output: raw_category

  - id: step_fetch_issue
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/jsonapi/node/magazine_issue?filter[issue_number]={{issue_number}}"
    output: raw_issue

  - id: step_validate_author
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_author
      schema: author_entity_schema
    output: validated_author

  - id: step_validate_category
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_category
      schema: category_term_schema
    output: validated_category

  - id: step_validate_issue
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_issue
      schema: magazine_issue_schema
    output: validated_issue

  - id: step_extract_author_id
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_author
      field: "data[0].id"
    output: author_entity_id

  - id: step_check_author_found
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "author_entity_id is not null"
      input_ref: author_entity_id
    output: author_found_result

  - id: step_route_author_missing
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "author_found_result == false"
      target: step_flag_manual_assignment

  - id: step_extract_category_uuid
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_category
      field: "data[0].attributes.uuid"
    output: category_term_uuid

  - id: step_extract_issue_uuid
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_issue
      field: "data[0].attributes.uuid"
    output: issue_uuid

  - id: step_merge_metadata
    op: merge_datasets
    params:
      input: author_entity_id
      secondary: category_term_uuid
      key: "article_id"
    output: partial_metadata

  - id: step_merge_issue
    op: merge_datasets
    params:
      input: partial_metadata
      secondary: issue_uuid
      key: "article_id"
    output: full_metadata

  - id: step_format_metadata
    op: format_output
    params:
      input: full_metadata
      format: "json"
    output: formatted_metadata

  - id: step_log_success
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: formatted_metadata
      message: "Metadata lookup completed successfully for article publication"
    output: audit_log_entry

  - id: step_terminate_success
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "completed"
      output_ref: formatted_metadata

  - id: step_flag_manual_assignment
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: validated_author
      recipient: "cms_editors"
      message: "Author not found for article. Manual author assignment required."
    output: notification_result

  - id: step_log_manual_flag
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: validated_author
      message: "Article flagged for manual author assignment - author entity not found"
    output: audit_flag_entry

  - id: step_terminate_flagged
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "flagged_manual_assignment"

steps:

    params:
      role: "cms_publisher"
    output: auth_result

  - id: step_fetch_author

    params:
      endpoint: "/jsonapi/node/author?filter[name]={{author_name}}"

    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/jsonapi/node/magazine_issue?filter[issue_number]={{issue_number}}"

    op: validate_schema
    params:

    params:

    params:
      condition: "author_found_result == false"
      target: step_flag_manual_assignment

    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: author_entity_id
      url: "/jsonapi/node/author/resolve"
      method: "GET"
    output: raw_author_resolved

  - id: step_lookup_category
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: category_term_uuid
      url: "/jsonapi/taxonomy_term/category/resolve"
      method: "GET"
    output: raw_category_resolved

  - id: step_lookup_issue
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: issue_uuid
      url: "/jsonapi/node/magazine_issue/resolve"
      method: "GET"
    output: raw_issue_resolved

  - id: step_sanitize_author_resolved
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: raw_author_resolved
      mapping: "identity"
    output: clean_author_resolved

  - id: step_sanitize_category_resolved
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: raw_category_resolved
      mapping: "identity"
    output: clean_category_resolved

  - id: step_sanitize_issue_resolved
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: raw_issue_resolved
      mapping: "identity"
    output: clean_issue_resolved

  - id: step_merge_metadata
    op: merge_datasets
    params:
      input: clean_author_resolved
      secondary: clean_category_resolved
      key: "article_id"
    output: partial_metadata

  - id: step_merge_issue
    op: merge_datasets
    params:
      input: partial_metadata
      secondary: clean_issue_resolved
      key: "article_id"
    output: full_metadata

  - id: step_format_metadata
    op: format_output
    params:
      input: full_metadata
      format: "json"
    output: formatted_metadata

  - id: step_log_success
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: formatted_metadata
      message: "Metadata lookup completed successfully for article publication"
    output: audit_log_entry

  - id: step_terminate_success
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "completed"
      output_ref: formatted_metadata

    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: validated_author
      recipient: "cms_editors"
      message: "Author not found for article. Manual author assignment required."
    output: notification_result

  - id: step_log_manual_flag
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: validated_author

    output: audit_flag_entry

  - id: step_terminate_flagged
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "flagged_manual_assignment"
